CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW session_events AS
WITH gaps AS (
 SELECT *, lag(happened_at) OVER (
   PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY happened_at, id
 ) AS previous_at FROM events
), starts AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_at IS NULL
   OR happened_at - previous_at > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
 FROM gaps
)
SELECT id, user_id, happened_at, event,
 sum(new_session) OVER (
   PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY happened_at, id
   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
 )::INTEGER AS session_no
FROM starts;

examples.title: Inspect Ada’s gaps before assigning sessions
examples.sql:
SELECT id, event, happened_at::TIME::VARCHAR AS time,
  date_diff('minute', lag(happened_at) OVER (
    ORDER BY happened_at, id), happened_at) AS gap_minutes
FROM events WHERE user_id = 1 AND happened_at::DATE = DATE '2026-01-05'
ORDER BY happened_at, id;

examples.title: Start a session only when the gap exceeds 30 minutes
examples.sql:
WITH gaps AS (
 SELECT *, lag(happened_at) OVER (
   PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY happened_at, id
 ) AS previous_at FROM events
), starts AS (
 SELECT *, CASE WHEN previous_at IS NULL
   OR happened_at - previous_at > INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
 FROM gaps
)
SELECT id, user_id, happened_at, event,
 sum(new_session) OVER (
   PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY happened_at, id
   ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
 )::INTEGER AS session_no
FROM starts
ORDER BY user_id, happened_at, id;

examples.title: Inspect Ada’s first two sessions
examples.sql:
SELECT session_no, count(*) AS events,
  min(happened_at)::TIME::VARCHAR AS start_time,
  date_diff('minute', min(happened_at), max(happened_at)) AS observed_minutes,
  bool_or(event IN ('run','enquiry')) AS engaged
FROM session_events
WHERE user_id = 1 AND happened_at::DATE = DATE '2026-01-05'
GROUP BY session_no ORDER BY session_no;

challenge.title: Find Ada’s single-event sessions
challenge.prompt: Return session_no for Ada (user_id = 1) where the session contains exactly one event, across the whole dataset.
challenge.hint: Group the already assigned events by session, then filter groups with HAVING.
challenge.starter: SELECT session_no FROM session_events WHERE user_id = 1 GROUP BY session_no ORDER BY session_no;
challenge.solution: SELECT session_no FROM session_events WHERE user_id = 1 GROUP BY session_no HAVING count(*) = 1 ORDER BY session_no;
challenge.success: Sessions 2, 3, and 4 contain one observed event each. Their observed duration is zero, which does not prove the visitor spent no time there.
